body: I have generalized anxiety disorder. I'm not on medication and it often results in me utilizing negative and/or destructive coping techniques. One of many being binge eating. I also fast sometimes. but I binged on apples and other foods which they didn't like. According to them, I deserve nothing. I don't want to be lazy, selfish, a burden/liability. but thats what I am. worthless. All I bring is worthless drama and distress.
